description: Compare two named tools side by side when the user asks 'A vs B' or 'should I use A or B'. Inputs: `a`, `b` tool ids (use search to resolve names). Returns for each: category, lowest paid price and plan text, free tier, skill level, needs coding, best for, 2 strengths, 2 weaknesses, and the VCP comparison page URL. For more than two tools use recommend_tools or scenario.

b.description: second tool id (use search to resolve names)

name: compare_tools
title: Compare two tools
